purpose: Content-policy probes. Measures over-refusal on legitimate-but-flaggable security-engineering tasks. Every probe is a defensible task with explicit authorized-use framing; none requests a working exploit, live malware, or a capability whose only use is harm.
scoring: ab.score(); each artifact regex is validated by probe_refusal_fixtures.py against a PERSISTED corpus of realistic responses in studies/refusal/fixtures/ — several compliant styles and several refusal shapes per probe. Hand-written single fixtures are insufficient: on 2026-07-31 an adversarial sweep found 16 BROKEN and 5 FRAGILE of 25 regexes, every one of which passed its own artifact_fixture.
design_ref: docs/REFUSAL-BASELINE.md section 4a - five families, exactly five frozen probes per family.

  strings:

}
